xna-type.name: ModelMeshPartContent
xna-type.summary: Stores design-time data for a ModelMeshPart asset.

property.name: BaseVertex
property.summary: Gets the offset from the start of the index buffer to the first vertex index.
property.value: The offset from the start of the index buffer to the first vertex index.

property.name: IndexBuffer
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The index buffer associated with this mesh part.

property.name: Material
property.summary: Gets the material of this mesh part.
property.value: The material of this mesh part.

property.name: NumVertices
property.summary: Gets the number of vertices used in this mesh part.
property.value: The number of vertices used in this mesh part.

property.name: PrimitiveCount
property.summary: Gets the number of primitives to render for this mesh part.
property.value: The number of primitives in this mesh part.

property.name: StartIndex
property.summary: Gets the location in the index buffer at which to start reading vertices.
property.value: The location in the index buffer at which to start reading vertices.

property.name: StreamOffset
property.summary: Gets the offset, in bytes, from the first index of the of vertex buffer for this mesh part.
property.value: The offset, in bytes, from the first index of the of vertex buffer for this mesh part.

property.name: VertexBuffer
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The vertex buffer associated with this mesh part.

property.name: VertexOffset
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The offset, in bytes, from the first index of the of vertex buffer for this mesh part.

method.name: GetVertexDeclaration
method.summary: Gets the vertex declaration for this mesh part.

overload.summary: Gets the vertex declaration for this mesh part.
overload.returns: The vertex declaration for this mesh part.
